title: The Secret Behind Antarctica’s Blood‑Red Lakes

scenes.text: Antarctica hides lakes that turn blood‑red every summer

scenes.label: MICROALGAE TURN WATER RED
scenes.text: Microscopic algae called Chlamydomonas produce a red pigment that stains the water

scenes.label: FREEZING POINT LOWERS
scenes.text: The high salinity from the algae lowers the freezing point, letting liquid water persist under the ice
scenes.query: salinity lowers freezing point antarctic lakes

scenes.label: UNIQUE ECOSYSTEM
scenes.text: These crimson pools host specialized microbes that survive in complete darkness and near‑freezing temps

description: Discover why some Antarctic lakes glow scarlet each summer and the tiny life that makes it happen. Stay curious and explore the unseen.
